The Increment Season is finally here, some of you would have received more than you thought and some of you would have received less.
And this would have pushed you into the Spiral of Comparison and Maybe Self doubt?

Where we evaluated

What their Spending Habits are and

Player 1: He makes less money compared to the other 2, save as much as he can and tries to maximise his investments…but is that enough to make him win ?
